name: pi-provider-claude-plus
description: Claude (Anthropic OAuth/subscription) layer for pi-coding-agent: keeps ALL extension tools usable under the subscription, plus a crash-safe multi-account pool with cross-process locking, keep-alive token refresh, 5h/weekly quota status, and a `cpool` CLI. Fork of @zgltyq/pi-provider-claude with the token-liveness model from claude-swap.
